name: OKC_K_LINES_TL_H
description:
Translatable columns from
                                         OKC_K_LINES_B, as per MLS standards.
                                         See OKC_K_LINES_B for a description of
                                         the table.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier. Primary key column of the base table.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: LINE_NAME
columns.description:
Free form text attribute for line
                                               name - translated.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description:
Free form text attribute for
                                               comments - translated.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description:
The description of the line item
                                               in source system. Denormalized
                                               for performance reasons -
                                               translated.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description:
Free form text attribute for line
                                               description - translated.

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.description:
The name of the line item in
                                               source system. Denormalized for
                                               performance reasons - translated.

columns.name: LINE_REFERENCE
columns.description:
Free form text attribute for line
                                               reference - translated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the Version Type. Valid values  'C' , 'A', 'H'
